fusions.name: Poke in the Pupil
fusions.desc: A two-finger jab that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and has a 35% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Open-Palm Stare
fusions.desc: Looks down a narrow cone 6 tiles long through an eye in your raised palm, dealing 28 arcane damage that ignores resistance to everything in it and leaving each target [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Hamsa Ward
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Double Take
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
